tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters quarterfinals Thursday: Alexander Zverev faces Alex de Minaur after edging Alexander Bublik; Arthur Gea meets Alejandro Davidovich Fokina • WTA Wuhan round of 16: Karolína Muchová battles Diana Shnaider as Iga Świątek and Ann Li headline later sessions • [SQUASH] Paul Coll sweeps Victor Crouin to reach the CIB Egyptian Open semis and will face Diego Elias; Sivasangari meets Hania El Hammamy for a place in the final • [BADMINTON] Denmark Open: He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu finally beat Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty 12-21, 21-15, 21-19 to reach the second round in Odense • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open moves to the pro round of 16 Thursday with PickleballTV and Tennis Channel coverage from Pickleball Virginia Beach • [TABLE TENNIS] Chinese Taipei juniors apologize after a camera flash disrupted the WTT China Smash final; ITTF World Hopes Week continues in Sheffield ahead of the Challenge on Oct. 17–18

newsItems.title: Shanghai QFs & Wuhan R16
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Shanghai’s Thursday card pairs Zverev with de Minaur and Gea with Davidovich Fokina, while WTA Wuhan’s round of 16 features Muchová–Shnaider and a Swiatek–Krueger night match.

newsItems.title: Coll Into Egyptian Open Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Second seed Paul Coll beat Victor Crouin 11-5, 11-6, 11-5 at the CIB Egyptian Open and will face Diego Elias for a spot in Sunday’s final in Giza.

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Round of 16
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour’s Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open hits the pro round of 16 Thursday, with gates at noon and Tennis Channel windows from 2–5 p.m. ET.

newsItems.title: Hopes Week in Sheffield
newsItems.excerpt: Thirty-six under-12 prospects from 26 nations are training at the ITTF World Hopes Week in Sheffield, with the giant round-robin Challenge set for Oct. 17–18.
